# Model-Based Agentic Engineering (MAGE)

<!-- GENERATED by catalog.py build (_llms_txt) — DO NOT EDIT. Every line is derived from the site build's own sources; regenerate with `python3 catalog.py build`. -->

> Model-Based Agentic Engineering (MAGE) is an engineering methodology for environments in which AI agents perform substantial implementation work.

MAGE has two principles that apply throughout the work. Modeling makes important engineering knowledge and intent explicit. Alignment makes important requirements effective by checking the work against them.

MAGE does not assume that engineers get everything right the first time. Software engineering routinely proceeds from incomplete, imprecise, and evolving requirements, and autonomous work exposes gaps that were not apparent in advance. MAGE therefore also emphasizes governance conversion: changing the engineering environment so that future work can inherit what was learned rather than rediscover it.

Rendered pages are `.html`; the catalogue's markdown sources are served at the same paths with `.md` and are the agent-friendly form.

## The mechanism catalogue (85 mechanisms)

- [Catalogue census](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/INDEX.md): one row per mechanism, grouped by family
- [Catalogue views](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/catalogue-views.html): every mechanism, grouped by role, family, form, and enforcement
- [Brief-linting](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/context-and-dispatch/brief-linting.md): Reject a malformed dispatch brief before it can launch.
- [Docs hierarchy + governance index](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/context-and-dispatch/docs-hierarchy.md): One enforced, numbered rule index every agent boots with.
- [Dynamic context injection](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/context-and-dispatch/dynamic-context-injection.md): Inject the rules governing these files into the brief.
- [Role-typed dispatch](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/context-and-dispatch/role-typed-dispatch.md): A typed role fixes LLM, isolation, and gates per dispatch.
- [Merge-train MIS batching](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/gates-and-merge-train/merge-train-mis-batching.md): Land non-conflicting worktrees together via a maximum independent set.
- [Pre-commit hook (3-stanza, tree-sha markers)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/gates-and-merge-train/pre-commit-hook.md): Cheap changed-file checks gate every commit, marker-verified.
- [Sentinel first-commit early-abort](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/gates-and-merge-train/sentinel-first-commit.md): Abort a broken agent at its first commit, not its last.
- [Staged deploy gates (canary → smoke → promote)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/gates-and-merge-train/staged-deploy-gates.md): Canary → smoke → promote; gate before users see it.
- [CLAUDE.md rule index (the governance document as a mechanism)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/governance-doc-controls/claude-md-rule-index.md): The governance document itself, enforced by its own lints.
- [Doc-hygiene lints (index coverage, autogen provenance)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/governance-doc-controls/doc-hygiene-lints.md): Lints keep docs indexed, provenance-headed, and cross-reference-valid.
- [Epic & design-doc templates](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/governance-doc-controls/epic-and-design-templates.md): Fixed section-templates for Epics and design docs so plans are complete.
- [Epic Definition-of-Done (Final-Opus trust-nothing re-run)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/governance-doc-controls/epic-definition-of-done.md): Close an Epic only after re-running its checks at HEAD.
- [Independent pre-implementation design review](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/governance-doc-controls/independent-design-review.md): Before code, a fresh non-author re-derives the design and rules on its open forks.
- [Mandatory snippet-table enforcement](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/governance-doc-controls/mandatory-snippet-table.md): Brief-linting asserts every required brief snippet is present.
- [Operational playbooks](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/governance-doc-controls/operational-playbooks.md): Situation-keyed devops procedures agents follow instead of improvising.
- [Operator runbook skill (positive map first, symptom index fallback)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/governance-doc-controls/operator-runbook-skill.md): Positive substrate map + symptom→doc routing, generated from typed YAML, ref-lint-checked.
- [Self-governance (detect your own recurring issues; convert each into a tasteful control)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/governance-doc-controls/self-governance.md): Detect a recurring failure class; convert it into a proportionate control, fired on a cadence.
- [Enforce at the right semantic level](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/governance-doc-controls/semantic-level-enforcement.md): Match a mechanism's enforcement scope to the semantic scope of the property it checks.
- [Agent registry (append-only log + marker cache)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/lifecycle-and-observability/agent-registry.md): Authoritative record of which agents are live right now.
- [Caused-by provenance (agent-side change traceability)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/lifecycle-and-observability/caused-by-provenance.md): A typed `caused-by` field, minted at the cause and gated at commit, threads a change to its reason.
- [Cron-alerts gate](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/lifecycle-and-observability/cron-alerts-gate.md): Block new dispatch while a HIGH cron alert is unresolved.
- [Deploy heartbeats + stale-worker detection](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/lifecycle-and-observability/deploy-heartbeats.md): Periodic liveness so a hung deploy differs from a slow one.
- [Lifecycle hooks (interpose on the agent runtime's events)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/lifecycle-and-observability/lifecycle-hooks.md): A hook on a runtime lifecycle event so an operator's omitted step can't be forgotten.
- [Reflection-facet substrate (tempo-gated policy nudges)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/lifecycle-and-observability/reflection-facet-substrate.md): Many policy-reflection nudges as one facet registry over a shared tempo budget — ≤1 emission/window.
- [Tombstone commits (lifecycle close records)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/lifecycle-and-observability/tombstone-commits.md): A close record proving a worktree is safe to reclaim.
- [Orchestrator-as-reactor over an event bus](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/lifecycle-and-observability/typed-event-bus.md): The orchestrator reacts to typed fleet events via a per-topic playbook.
- [Aggregate-compute protection (`lint-all` host mutex)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/mediators-and-resource-locks/aggregate-compute-protection.md): One lint-all per host; one in flight per orchestrator.
- [Build-serializer (M=8 semaphore)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/mediators-and-resource-locks/build-serializer.md): Cap concurrent heavy builds with an M=8 host semaphore.
- [Resource-pressure gating (admit before, shed during)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/mediators-and-resource-locks/resource-pressure-gating.md): One pressure signal gates heavy work at admission and execution — admit before, shed during.
- [Test-serializer (N=1 flock on `dotnet test`)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/agent/mediators-and-resource-locks/test-serializer.md): Serialize dotnet test to a single writer per host.
- [The agent-first MBSE harness](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/agent-first-mbse-harness.md): Structured frozen-record models + five hand-rolled disciplines; adopt the schema, skip the runtime.
- [Agent-orchestration model (developer journeys)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/agent-orchestration-model.md): The fleet + orchestrator loop modeled with the product's own MBSE method: developer journeys.
- [Component & zone model](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/component-zone-model.md): A typed map of every component's code zone and seams.
- [Composed state-machine model (typed lifecycles + cross-machine invariants)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/composed-state-machine-model.md): Typed state machines + cross-machine invariants, each routed to its checker by its shape.
- [Mediator & single-writer contracts](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/concurrency-contracts.md): Declared mediator and single-writer contracts, coverage-checked.
- [Control-coverage census (controls per governance target)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/control-coverage-census.md): Classify each control by its governance target; roll up per target; an empty target is a gap.
- [Control↔substrate dependency (computed blast-radius)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/control-substrate-dependency.md): Each control declares its substrate assumption as metadata; a query computes the blast radius.
- [Coverage → model-node mapping (which invariants are actually tested)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/coverage-model-mapping.md): Project test coverage onto model nodes (states, seams, invariants) so untested ones are visible.
- [Compliance data-flow model (typed sinks and edges for privacy reasoning)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/data-flow-model.md): Typed sinks and edges for a governed data kind, so privacy and erasure are a model walk.
- [Deployment & tier topology](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/deployment-topology-model.md): Structured models of where things run and how they layer.
- [Domain registries](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/domain-registries.md): Frozen typed registries for the system's domain facts.
- [Drift & parity gates](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/drift-parity-gates.md): Bidirectional model↔reality checks so models cannot drift.
- [Executable source-of-truth models](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/executable-source-of-truth.md): Structured models read every run and generated from; can't drift.
- [Formal invariant verification (temporal form → model checking)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/formal-invariant-verification.md): Each invariant's temporal-logic form derives its checker — proven, not sampled.
- [Governance graph (mechanism-interaction model)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/governance-graph.md): A typed graph of the governance mechanisms, edged by their conflicts over shared resources.
- [Invariant-DAG execution policy (a typed Scheduler separates correctness from resource + cost)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/invariant-dag-execution-policy.md): A DAG holds correctness + cost-gate edges only; a typed Scheduler rations load + budget per host.
- [Journey-criticality → test-tier placement (which host a test runs on, derived)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/journey-criticality-test-placement.md): A journey's criticality derives its test's host tier; a lint holds the local-coverage floor.
- [Journey task-closure (type the terminal post-condition, derive its strength)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/journey-task-closure.md): Type a journey's terminal assertion as a boolean over observables; a derived strength gates it.
- [Lifecycle model (typed operational map → generated runbook)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/lifecycle-model.md): Typed map of the system's operation: per-lifecycle health predicate, generating the runbook.
- [Meta-model consumption discipline (read, don't hardcode)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/meta-model-consumption.md): Read the model at runtime; never hardcode a snapshot.
- [Model-derived test-obligation census (derive what should be tested, lint the gap)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/model-derived-test-obligation-census.md): Derive the should-be-tested set from the models and lint the gap to the tests that exist.
- [Model-driven codegen](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/model-driven-codegen.md): Generate real artifacts from the models, provenance-headed.
- [Model-graded finding severity (distance-graded gate)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/model-graded-finding-severity.md): A gate grades each finding block/warn/silence by its model-distance from the changed files.
- [Orphan-coverage metric (walk code → governance; score the un-covered remainder)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/orphan-coverage-metric.md): Walk code → governing model/control; score the orphans; each orphan cluster is candidate work.
- [Process view (concurrent processes, lanes, and racing edges)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/process-view.md): Concurrent processes, their lanes, and the edges where they race over shared state.
- [Model query surface (`repo-query`)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/query-surface.md): repo-query — the agent-facing read API over the models.
- [Required-configuration-per-role manifest (admission policy on complete env)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/required-config-per-role-manifest.md): Role × plane → the complete required config set, checked as an admission policy at start-up.
- [Rule-metadata registry (machine-readable metadata on governance rules)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/rule-metadata-registry.md): Machine-readable metadata on each governance rule, extracted into a typed, queryable registry.
- [Service-flow / API model](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/service-flow-model.md): The SOA source-of-truth NetworkPolicy and wiring are generated from.
- [Symbol-anchored traceability graph (derived edges)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/symbol-anchored-traceability-graph.md): A typed model↔lint↔code↔proof↔registry graph whose edges are derived, symbol-anchored, re-checked.
- [Synchronization model (meta-sync)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/synchronization-model.md): A registry of every lock, what it guards, and its ordering.
- [Telemetry-collection provenance (per-stream origin, landing, per-env coverage)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/telemetry-collection-provenance.md): Each telemetry stream's origin, landing, and per-environment coverage as a checkable record.
- [Timeout-budget ordering model (nested wall-clock budgets, checked)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/timeout-budget-ordering-model.md): Scattered wall-clock budgets unified into one surface with a checkable nesting order.
- [Typed contract surfaces (the contract is a checked model, not a comment)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/typed-contract-surfaces.md): The contract between two parties is a structured, checked model, not a shared assumption.
- [User-journey model (product-goal → implementation bridge)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/models-bridge/system-models/user-journey-model.md): User journeys as typed entities: actor, goal, ordered steps joined to the endpoints they cross.
- [Canonical walkers (one traversal per tree)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/canonical-models-and-seams/canonical-walkers.md): One canonical traversal per tree, not ad hoc recursion.
- [Office Models ({Slides,Docs,Sheets}Model)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/canonical-models-and-seams/office-models.md): All OOXML through structured models; raw SDK access banned.
- [PdfModel (sole PDF mutation surface)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/canonical-models-and-seams/pdf-model.md): All PDF I/O through one structured model; raw canonical-PDF-library access banned.
- [Sole raw-Redis seam (the dispatch module)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/canonical-models-and-seams/raw-redis-seam.md): All raw Redis in one seam; queue atomicity encoded once.
- [ServiceClient (typed cross-service seam)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/canonical-models-and-seams/service-client.md): A BinaryIO seam makes file-path-over-wire impossible.
- [`a11y_` prefix convention](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/provenance-and-attribution/a11y-prefix.md): Prefix invisible inserts so they're distinguishable and tracked.
- [`derive-changelog` (reconstruct mutations)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/provenance-and-attribution/derive-changelog.md): Reconstruct the attributed mutation history from the stamps.
- [F10 mutator-stamp-wiring lint](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/provenance-and-attribution/f10-wiring-lint.md): Fail the build if any mutator verb lacks a stamp.
- [Per-mutator attribution stamps](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/provenance-and-attribution/mutator-stamps.md): Every mutation embeds an attribution stamp in the artifact.
- [DDT pin-trailers (doc-derived characterization)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/regression-tests/ddt-pin-trailers.md): Doc-derived characterization pinned to a cited source.
- [Fuzz campaigns (+ auto-coverage)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/regression-tests/fuzz-campaigns.md): Malformed-input campaigns; fix to the spec, not the seed.
- [FsCheck property tests](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/regression-tests/property-tests.md): FsCheck invariants over generated inputs find hidden bugs.
- [Test-onion tiers (Smoke / Lite / targeted / full)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/regression-tests/test-onion-tiers.md): Cost-stratified test tiers: Smoke, Lite, targeted, full.
- [Codemod-first threshold (N≳50 → AST transformer)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/repair-vocabulary/codemod-first.md): For 50+ deterministic sites, write one AST transformer.
- [Closed remediation-verb sets](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/repair-vocabulary/remediation-verbs.md): A closed, named set of remediation actions — bounded moves.
- [Typed `ViolationCategory` / `FailureCategory` enums](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/repair-vocabulary/typed-categories.md): Typed enums replace free-form failure strings.
- [Cross-source coherence lints](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/validation-and-conformance/coherence-lints.md): Assert independent sources agree — catch cross-source drift.
- [ContentValidator (input ⊆ output fidelity)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/validation-and-conformance/content-validator.md): Assert input content survives remediation — a fidelity gate.
- [The Audit-to-Lint mechanism (blocking semantic lints)](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/validation-and-conformance/semantic-lints.md): The blocking semantic-lint fleet over the tool's own source.
- [Standards / WCAG rule engine](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/product/validation-and-conformance/standards-rule-engine.md): Map each finding to the WCAG/508/PDF-UA criterion it closes.

## Teach with MAGE

## Model Workbench

- [Model Workbench](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/workbench/index.html): open a MAGE model system in the browser; fully client-side
- [Learn: Working with a coding agent](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/workbench/learn.html#guide-working-with-a-coding-agent): One shared workspace: a human in the page, and a coding agent driving the same model system through window.mage.
- [Learn the Workbench](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/workbench/learn.html)
- [MAGE model system](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/workbench/mage-model.schema.json): A model system: one identity namespace of entities, zero or more graph models, zero or more state machines.
- [MAGE query and query result](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/workbench/mage-query.schema.json): A question asked of a model system, and the shape of the answer.
- [MAGE model transaction](https://davisjam.github.io/model-based-agentic-software-engineering/workbench/mage-transaction.schema.json): An all-or-nothing change to a model system.
